rationale: The landfill spotter actually positions trucks for dumping and is killed by an arriving backing truck. This directly establishes truck-dumping coordination; the evidence was discovered while reviewing another original Task ID.

historical_description: Saw felled trees into lengths.
official_description: Saw felled trees into lengths.

This establishes sawing a felled tree into sections, beyond merely felling or walking near logs. Recovered from ranked original-linked evidence; the earlier insufficient-evidence judgment is preserved.
activity_quote: As he started cutting up the fallen log, the nearby tree fell naturally, due to rot.
incident_quote: The employee was crushed. He died from his injuries while still onsite.
rationale: The logger had already felled the tree and was cutting up that fallen log when a separate decayed tree fell onto him. Recovered from ranked original-linked evidence; the earlier insufficient-evidence judgment is preserved.

Cutting up the log establishes sawing the felled tree into lengths, and the adjacent rotten tree strikes him during that activity. historical_description: Clean work area.

incident_quote: Employee #1 struck rebar that was extending out of the top of the concrete wall during the fall.

confirmation_rationale: The worker assisted scaffold erection and laid a plywood platform before anchor failure caused collapse and injury; scaffold erection is explicit and incident-involved.

historical_description: Operate equipment such as forklifts.

confirmation_rationale: The worker actually operated the forklift and was killed in its overturn. Unauthorized use does not negate performance of this task.

historical_description: Train staff members.

confirmation_rationale: The supervisor cut PVC while training a temporary employee and was injured by the saw during that instruction, directly establishing staff training.

historical_description: Collaborate with other workers to locate and correct malfunctions.
official_description: Collaborate with other workers to locate and correct malfunctions.
followup_rationale: Two utility workers jointly undertake locating and repairing the failed street-light circuit; the fault is located in the hand hole and the lineman reaches in to repair it. The groundsman is elsewhere around the same house when the lineman is electrocuted; teamwork need not mean simultaneous contact with the equipment.
activity_quote: Two utility workers were in a residential area to locate and repair an electrical problem that was causing a street light not to work.
incident_quote: His hand contacted a part energized at 12 0 volts, and he was electrocuted.
rationale: Two utility workers jointly undertake locating and repairing the failed street-light circuit; the fault is located in the hand hole and the lineman reaches in to repair it. The groundsman is elsewhere around the same house when the lineman is electrocuted; teamwork need not mean simultaneous contact with the equipment.
confirmation_rationale: The two-worker team locates the failed street-light circuit in a vault, and its lineman reaches in to repair it. This documents joint location and correction work even though the groundsman is on the other side of the house when contact occurs.

historical_description: Dig trenches.
official_description: Dig trenches.

incident_quote: The left side of the trench collapsed causing dirt to engulf Employee #1.  The employee was fatally injured.
rationale: Two masons explicitly dig the trench manually with shovels and continue excavating inside it. The deeper side collapses and fatally engulfs one of them. Another report also explicitly describes trench digging around a palm tree during an antelope attack.
confirmation_rationale: The affected mason explicitly continues digging the trench with his coworker when its wall collapses, directly matching trench digging.

historical_description: Signal crane operators to move equipment.

confirmation_rationale: The flagman signalled repositioning of the crane/concrete bucket; the ensuing boom movement and cable failure killed the carpenter. This is directly involved signalling, not a job-title inference.

historical_description: Bathe patients.

activity_quote: was performing duties which involved contact with patients including bed baths
incident_quote: The employee contracted COVID-19 and died April 7, 2020.

confirmation_rationale: The patient care technician performed bed baths and contacted patients who later tested positive. This directly supports bathing patients in the exposure narrative, without identifying which individual patient-care act transmitted infection.

historical_description: Remove old roofing materials.

confirmation_rationale: Removing existing damaged roofing is the described task; the narrative explicitly links the removal operation to the fatal fall.

historical_description: Operate car washes.
followup_rationale: The employee explicitly controls and operates the car-wash conveyor after washing the vehicle. Attempting to clean residual dirt as it moves causes a fall in front of the vehicle and fractured ribs. Other examples also show operation of the automated car-wash system.

incident_quote: The car struck the employee as he was falling to the ground.
rationale: The employee explicitly controls and operates the car-wash conveyor after washing the vehicle. Attempting to clean residual dirt as it moves causes a fall in front of the vehicle and fractured ribs. Other examples also show operation of the automated car-wash system.
confirmation_rationale: The affected employee starts the conveyor to operate the automatic wash and is struck by the car it is moving while trying to finish cleaning the bumper. This directly establishes operating the car wash during the incident.

historical_description: Load machines onto trucks to prepare for transportation.
official_description: Load machines onto trucks to prepare for transportation.

activity_quote: BOTH TRUCKS WERE THEN USED TO PICK UP THE LOAD SO THAT IT WOULD CLEAR THE EDGE OF THE TRUCK BED.

confirmation_rationale: Coworkers actively raise warehouse machinery with two forklifts and a hoist to transfer it onto a flatbed truck. The load falls during this loading operation and crushes the observing employee. This is incident-involved machine loading, beyond a statement of future transport.

historical_description: Coordinate and supervise work of kitchen staff.
official_description: Coordinate and supervise work of kitchen staff.
activity_quote: Before having a worker begin cleaning the oven, Employee # 1 turned the burner valves to the 'off' position. She then had the worker remove the top of the oven to reveal that the pilot lights were lit.
incident_quote: Employee #1 was killed and the worker suffered minor injuries.

confirmation_rationale: The manager directs and coordinates a worker cleaning an oven in the cooking area and intervenes in the preparation; both are injured in the resulting gas explosion. Supervision is evidenced by instructions/actions, not title alone.

historical_description: Disassemble and remove damaged or worn pipe.
official_description: Disassemble and remove damaged or worn pipe.

activity_quote: Employees #1, #2 and #3 were removing a damaged 21 foot pipe and auger system
incident_quote: The pipe and auger system slipped from the chain and homemade hoisting apparatus crushing Employee #1's hands.
rationale: The crew detaches and removes the damaged pipe-and-auger assembly from a fertilizer spreader, maneuvering its boot with pry bars and hoisting it. The removed assembly slips and crushes the worker hands. This establishes damaged-pipe disassembly/removal rather than handling undamaged new pipe.
confirmation_rationale: The employees remove a damaged pipe-and-auger assembly from a fertilizer spreader, maneuvering its boot with pry bars and lifting it from the machine. This constitutes disassembly/removal of a damaged pipe assembly; its slipping during removal injures the participating worker.

historical_description: Raise vehicles, using hydraulic jacks.
official_description: Raise vehicles, using hydraulic jacks.

confirmation_rationale: The narrative identifies hydraulic jacks actually used to raise the truck; their collapse during the repair killed the worker. This establishes involvement although injury followed the initial raising.

historical_description: Operate safety equipment and use safe work habits.
official_description: Operate safety equipment and use safe work habits.

confirmation_rationale: Actual use of safety belts/lanyards and tie-off documents safety-equipment use and a protective work practice. The tied-off worker fell after the platform and safety line failed. This does not imply safety equipment caused the injury or that every practice was safe.

historical_description: Direct other workers to move stakes, place blocks, position anchors or cables, or move materials.

confirmation_rationale: Radioing the crane to raise a trash-filled skip directs another worker to move materials, one explicit alternative in the task. The movement caused the fall.

historical_description: Maneuver completed roofing units into position for installation.

confirmation_rationale: Placing roofing panels documents maneuvering roofing units for installation. The fatal fall occurred while returning to the bundle as part of that work cycle.

historical_description: Dump refuse or recyclable materials at disposal sites.

confirmation_rationale: The injured worker explicitly replaced the motor; faults in that installation energized the conveyor he then touched. The completed replacement is directly involved in this incident, not unrelated background.

confirmation_rationale: The preceding sentence specifies the wire-rope sling had come off the water pipe. Reattaching that sling was the injured worker's explicit activity.

historical_description: Repair or replace gas piping.

confirmation_rationale: Actual clearing of overlapped material from the roller grooves is described, including reversing the machine; additional component adjustment is conditional, not mandatory.

historical_description: Drill holes in timbers or lumber.
official_description: Drill holes in timbers or lumber.
activity_quote: THE EMPLOYEE HAD FINISHED USING A GROUNDED 0.5-INCH MILWAUKEE DRILL TO DRILL HOLES IN THE WOODEN POST.
incident_quote: THE OWNER LEFT FOR MORE MATERIALS; AND, WHEN HE RETURNED, HE FOUND THE EMPLOYEE DEAD.
rationale: The worker drilled bolt holes in a wooden gate post using the electrically faulty drill and was found dead after that operation.
confirmation_rationale: Drilling bolt holes in a wooden gate post directly matches drilling timbers. Employee was found dead during the same installation; the drill case was energized. Exact contact was unwitnessed, but drilling itself is explicit.

historical_description: Operate fork lifts, skid loaders, or trucks to move or store recyclable materials.
official_description: Operate fork lifts, skid loaders, or trucks to move or store recyclable materials.
activity_quote: the forklift operator was using a Caterpillar, model V50, forklift to load brown scrap paper bundles onto a truck going to a recycle yard.
incident_quote: Employee #1 was struck and fatally crushed by one or two bundles of brown cardboard scrap paper, each weighing approximately 1,140 lb.
rationale: A forklift operator moved scrap-paper bundles onto a truck for a recycling yard; the stack behind the handled load fell and killed a nearby worker.
confirmation_rationale: Forklift operator was moving explicitly recyclable scrap paper; the adjoining stack fell onto the victim during that loading operation.

historical_description: Direct or monitor work of press crews.
official_description: Direct or monitor work of press crews.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was attempting to show a power press operator how to remove pieces from a die.
incident_quote: Employee #1 had his right hand in the die when the operator cycled the press, causing the three middle fingers of his right hand to be amputated.
rationale: The affected worker was directing a press operator through a demonstration of die-piece removal when the operator cycled the press on his hand. The task description does not restrict the press type. Report 707877 is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Instruction of the press operator directly evidences directing press work; the instructor was injured during that demonstration.

historical_description: Remove cooked material or products from equipment.
official_description: Remove cooked material or products from equipment.
activity_quote: Employee #2 finished what she was doing, and, thinking plenty of time had passed for the pressure in the fryer to dissipate, tried to open the fryer to get the chicken out.
incident_quote: When the lid came off, hot grease splashed out, burning both employees.
rationale: Both injured employees attempted to open the pressure fryer to retrieve cooked chicken; the hot grease release occurred in that removal operation.
confirmation_rationale: Workers actively opened the fryer as the first step of removing cooked chicken after its timer sounded. Both were burned during that removal operation; successful extraction is not required.

historical_description: Lubricate moving parts.
official_description: Lubricate moving parts.
activity_quote: He was using a stick wax for lubrication and wearing gloves at the time of the accident.
incident_quote: When he applied the stick wax to the drill, his glove caught in the drill bit and pulled his finger into it.
rationale: Victim applied lubricating wax to rotating drill and glove pulled his finger into bit.
confirmation_rationale: The worker applied wax lubricant to the moving drill and his glove was caught. This directly establishes lubricating a moving part.

historical_description: Load logs or wood onto trucks, trailers, or railroad cars, by hand or using loaders or winches.
official_description: Load logs or wood onto trucks, trailers, or railroad cars, by hand or using loaders or winches.
activity_quote: On the opposite side of the trailer, a coworker had just finished loading the trailer using a Polar preloa d vehicle.
incident_quote: a log rolled off the middle pile and struck Employee #1 on the head, killing him.
rationale: A coworker loaded logs onto the trailer and one of that load's unsecured logs rolled onto the driver. The narrative is slightly inconsistent about whether loading had just finished or was still completing, but direct loading involvement is clear.
confirmation_rationale: Coworker loaded logs onto the trailer, and a just-loaded log fell onto the driver preparing to secure it. Timing of completion is described inconsistently, but performed loading and direct involvement are explicit.

historical_description: Feed products into machines by hand or conveyor.
official_description: Feed products into machines by hand or conveyor.
activity_quote: As she was stuffing cheese into the vertical feed opening of the meat grinder, her index, middle, and ring fingers were caught in the horizontal auger.
incident_quote: The employee was hospitalized.
rationale: The injured operator manually stuffed cheese into a grinder feed opening and caught her fingers in the auger.
confirmation_rationale: Explicit manual feeding of cheese into a grinder directly led to caught fingers.

historical_description: Dust furniture, walls, machines, or equipment.
official_description: Dust furniture, walls, machines, or equipment.
activity_quote: SHE REACHED INTO THE FRAME OF THE PRODUCT CONVEYOR METAL DETECTOR TO DUST OFF A PLATE WHICH COVERED A CONVEYOR BELT.
incident_quote: SHE WAS UNABLE TO RELEASE HER GRIP ON THE DIAPER IN TIME TO PREVENT HER HAND AND ARM FROM BEING PULLED INTO THE NIP POINT FORMED WHERE THE BELT RAN ONTO THE ROLLER.
rationale: The technician dusted a conveyor cover plate with a diaper and was drawn into the running belt.
confirmation_rationale: Employee explicitly dusted an equipment plate with cloth and was pulled into the running belt.

historical_description: Shovel, sweep, or otherwise clean work areas.
official_description: Shovel, sweep, or otherwise clean work areas.
activity_quote: He had been told to help laborers clean up the area by picking up boards and lodged lumber. Apparently he accidentally picked up a 4 by 8 3/4 ft plywood sheet that was covering a 3 1/2 by 6 1/2 ft opening in the floor.
incident_quote: When he picked up the sheet he went through the opening and fell approximately 42 ft to the ground. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: The victim picked up boards during site cleanup and lifted a floor-hole cover, falling through it.
confirmation_rationale: Sweeping the store front and returning its broom form the directly involved work operation; electrocution occurred during broom replacement immediately afterward.

historical_description: Operate cutting torches or welding equipment to cut or join metal parts.
official_description: Operate cutting torches or welding equipment to cut or join metal parts.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1, A WELDER, WAS USING A GAS WELDING TORCH TO CUT MOUNTING HOLES FOR BOLTS IN A STEEL PLATE LOCATED ATOP AN IMHOFF DIGESTER TANK.
incident_quote: EMPLOYEES #1 AND #2 WERE KNOCKED BACK AWAY FROM THE WELDING AREA WHEN A SPARK FROM THE CUTTING OPERATION FELL AND IGNITED METHANE GAS IN THE DIGESTER TANK.
rationale: Victim cut bolt holes in a steel plate with gas torch; sparks ignited digester methane and injured him.
confirmation_rationale: Torch cutting of steel is directly evidenced; cutting sparks ignited the tank gas and both workers were hospitalized.

historical_description: Tend or operate machine that packages product.
official_description: Tend or operate machine that packages product.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was operating a Multivac packaging machine.
incident_quote: The distal aspect of her left ring finger was amputated.
rationale: The affected worker operated a packaging machine and lifted its conveyor to cut film when it indexed on her finger.
confirmation_rationale: The packaging-machine operator was injured when the machine indexed during film handling at the end of the operating shift.

historical_description: Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components.
official_description: Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components.
activity_quote: They successfully completed installing a clip on the first phase conductor.
incident_quote: Both employees received burns to their arms and faces from the ensuing electric arc and were hospitalized for their injuries.
rationale: Electricians connected monitor clips/conductors at circuit breaker and were burned when screwdriver shorted enclosure.
confirmation_rationale: Installing the monitor connections on circuit-breaker conductors is actual electrical connection work; completing one connection then attempting the next caused the arc injury.

historical_description: Assist in the cleanup of hazardous material spills.
official_description: Assist in the cleanup of hazardous material spills.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS WASHING SPILLED DIESEL FUEL IN A YARD AREA.
incident_quote: HE COLLAPSED AND DIED FROM ACUTE PULMONARY CONGESTION AND HEMORRHAGE AND MARKED CEREBRAL EDEMA, DUE TO AN ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTION.
rationale: Victim washed a diesel spill and collapsed fatally during cleanup; no additional coworker is required by assisting cleanup.
confirmation_rationale: The worker was cleaning spilled diesel fuel when he collapsed and died. This is incident-involved spill cleanup, not post-incident rescue.

historical_description: Construct forms or chutes for pouring concrete.
official_description: Construct forms or chutes for pouring concrete.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was laying 4-ft by 8-ft-0.75in. plywood decking on the sixth floor for pouring concrete floor.
incident_quote: Employee #1 stepped back on a 3-ft by 4 in. rib and fell 12 ft to a concrete floor, fracturing his right wrist.
rationale: The injured worker laid plywood decking as a concrete floor pouring form and fell from the support rib during this construction.
confirmation_rationale: Plywood decking placed to receive poured concrete is concrete form construction; the fall occurred during this work.

historical_description: Operate loaders to pull out stumps, rip asphalt or concrete, rough-grade properties, bury refuse, or perform general cleanup.
official_description: Operate loaders to pull out stumps, rip asphalt or concrete, rough-grade properties, bury refuse, or perform general cleanup.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was using a Bobcat loader to pick up rubbish at a construction site.
incident_quote: The bucket descended suddenly, catching and crushing his body. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: The victim operated a Bobcat to pick up construction rubbish and was crushed while addressing plastic caught around a wheel during that cleanup.
confirmation_rationale: Loader-operated rubbish cleanup is an explicit task alternative; the worker was killed by the bucket during that operation.

historical_description: Repair or replace damaged equipment.
official_description: Repair or replace damaged equipment.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 HAD ATTEMPTED TO REPAIR A BROKEN DRUM LINE BUT COULD NOT.
incident_quote: HE WAS THROWN INTO THE PATH OF THE RIGHT TRACK, RUN OVER, AND CRUSHED.
rationale: The victim attempted repair of a broken drum line, then carried it while boarding the dozer; that line released the brake and caused the fatal runover.
confirmation_rationale: Actual attempted repair of the broken drum line is reported, followed by moving that broken line while boarding the machine. Its contact with the brake release initiated the fatal sequence. Unsuccessful repair remains performed activity; the report reconstructs the incident from evidence.

historical_description: Stock shelves with products.
official_description: Stock shelves with products.
activity_quote: An employee was working in a component storeroom, restocking the shelf of Everea dy 6-volt dry cell batteries.
incident_quote: The employee was struck in the right eye by leaking corrosive material.
rationale: The injured worker was restocking a shelf with batteries and handling the stock when corrosive material splashed his eye.
confirmation_rationale: Restocking batteries on a shelf is explicit; handling a damaged battery in that process caused an eye burn. The split brand name does not change the action.

historical_description: Perform general labor duties such as repairing booms.
official_description: Perform general labor duties such as repairing booms.
activity_quote: Employee #2 was on the barge arranging the rigging to hook up the template to the crane's two wire rope lifting cables.
incident_quote: Employee #2 was knocked into the river by a cable that whipped across the barge when the boom collapsed.
rationale: Arranging crane rigging is a general labor duty directly performed by the worker injured when the boom collapsed; boom repair is an illustrative example rather than a required action.
confirmation_rationale: Rigging a load is performed general labor and the rigging worker was injured by the collapsing crane. The task says such as repairing booms, an illustrative example; no boom repair is asserted here. This broad task warrants a granularity caveat.

historical_description: Lift or move materials and finished products, using large cranes.
official_description: Lift or move materials and finished products, using large cranes.
activity_quote: ON THE FIRST LIFT, THE CRANE WAS LIFTING 6 SHEETS OF PLYWOOD
incident_quote: THE CRANE TIPPED OVER TOWARD THE EXCAVATION. THE OPERATOR JUMPED FREE AND WAS NOT INJURED.
rationale: A 35-ton crane lifted plywood and overturned, directly endangering its operator, who jumped clear. Injury is not necessary where an accident during the activity is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: A 35-ton crane lifted manufactured plywood sheets and tipped over in that operation. This establishes an accident-associated material/finished-product lift, explicitly without an injury to this operator.

historical_description: Cut timbers, lumber, or paneling to specified dimensions.
official_description: Cut timbers, lumber, or paneling to specified dimensions.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS OPERATING A TABLE SAW, CUTTING PLYWOOD PANELS TO SIZE.
incident_quote: A PIECE OF SCRAP WOOD PULLED HIS RIGHT HAND INTO THE BLADE, RESULTING IN THE AMPUTATION OF THE MIDDLE FINGER OF HIS RIGHT HAND AT THE FIRST JOINT.
rationale: The injured saw operator explicitly cut plywood panels to size. One other report is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Cutting plywood panels to size is explicit dimensioned panel cutting and directly produced a hand injury.

historical_description: Press buttons to activate cleaning equipment or machines.
official_description: Press buttons to activate cleaning equipment or machines.
activity_quote: After he finished cleaning, he leaned over and hit the equipment safety button.
incident_quote: The machine activated, trapping his legs in the pinch point at the base.
rationale: Victim hit machine button following mold cleaning; activation trapped his legs. Activation by button is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: He pressed the machine button and the machine activated, injuring his leg. Acceptance uses the literal machines alternative; the machine manufactures molds and is not itself asserted to be a dedicated cleaning machine. Task wording is broad and interpretation should be audited.

historical_description: Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
official_description: Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
activity_quote: THE EMPLOYEES WERE UNLOADING A TRUCK AND MANUALLY PLACING THE MERCHANDISE ONTO A ROLLER-TYPE CONVEYOR (BELT DRIVEN).
incident_quote: SOME OF THE BOTTLES BROKE, RELEASING HARMFUL VAPORS INTO THE WORKPLACE.
rationale: The affected employees unloaded goods from a truck and loaded them onto a conveyor; pushing those goods caused a chemical spill and exposure. These are the task's unloading/loading actions across conveyance and conveyor.
confirmation_rationale: The workers unloaded the truck and loaded a conveyor; a package fell during that work, releasing fumes and sending five exposed workers to hospitals for observation.

historical_description: Mow or edge lawns, using power mowers or edgers.
official_description: Mow or edge lawns, using power mowers or edgers.
activity_quote: He was cutting grass at the side of a house
incident_quote: The mower then ran over his foot, amputating his big toe.
rationale: The affected lawn-service worker cut residential grass using a riding power mower that threw and ran over him. Report 170081921 is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Actual power mowing of a residential lawn is explicit; brake lockup threw the worker and the mower amputated his toe.

historical_description: Install electrical cables or wire fixtures.
official_description: Install electrical cables or wire fixtures.
activity_quote: An electrician was installing wiring for a heating element.
incident_quote: The ensuing electric arc burned the employee on his face and on one arm.
rationale: The injured electrician installed wiring for a heater and contacted the energized panel bus.
confirmation_rationale: Actual wiring installation at the breaker panel is evidenced and led to an arc injury.

historical_description: Replace light bulbs.
official_description: Replace light bulbs.
activity_quote: Two employees were replacing a burned out bulb in a lighting fixture in a machine shop bay.
incident_quote: One of the two employees contacted the 277-volt leads from an adapter that had been placed in the socket for the bulb. He was electrocuted.
rationale: The affected employee was replacing a burned-out light bulb and contacted energized leads at the socket.
confirmation_rationale: Actual bulb replacement exposed a worker to energized fixture leads and caused electrocution.

historical_description: Dismantle structures or equipment.
official_description: Dismantle structures or equipment.
activity_quote: Three employees were dismantling three sections of a welded-metal tubular-frame scaffold.
incident_quote: One of the employees, who was handling a 28-foot-long aluminum walk board, brought it into contact with a 7620-volt overhead power line. He was electrocuted.
rationale: The employee dismantled scaffold sections and contacted a power line with the aluminum walkboard he was handling.
confirmation_rationale: Scaffold dismantling is explicit; handling a dismantled walkboard contacted the overhead line and killed a worker.

historical_description: Participate in firefighting efforts.
official_description: Participate in firefighting efforts.
activity_quote: Three fire fighters went on the platform while five fire fighters were below.
incident_quote: The platform collapsed on the fire fighters, pinning them in fire debris including soaked paper and burning wood.
rationale: Firefighters responding to fire entered storage platform that collapsed onto them in burning debris.
confirmation_rationale: Firefighters were on/under a platform at an active fire, which collapsed and injured them. Response work itself was the activity involving their injuries, so it qualifies.

historical_description: Take actions to avoid potential hazards or obstructions, such as utility lines, other equipment, other workers, or falling objects.
official_description: Take actions to avoid potential hazards or obstructions, such as utility lines, other equipment, other workers, or falling objects.
activity_quote: A CABLE TELEVISION CABLE WAS ON HIS TRAILER'S LOAD, AND THE EMPLOYEE WAS TRYING TO CLEAR THE CABLE FROM THE LOAD--A DRILLING RIG SUBSTRUCTURE.
incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE SUSTAINED BURNS TO HIS HANDS AND FEET FROM THE ELECTRIC SHOCK AND HEAD INJURIES FROM THE FALL. THE EMPLOYEE DIED OF HIS INJURIES.
rationale: The truck driver tried to clear a cable obstruction from his load and suffered fatal electrical contact and a fall during that action.
confirmation_rationale: The driver was actively removing an obstructing utility cable; slipping during that task led to electric contact, a fall and death. This is performed obstruction avoidance rather than a proposed precaution.

historical_description: Climb trees, using climbing hooks and belts, or climb ladders to gain access to work areas.
official_description: Climb trees, using climbing hooks and belts, or climb ladders to gain access to work areas.
activity_quote: THE EMPLOYEE USED A LADDER CLIMBING DEVICE TO REACH THE WORK AREA
incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE FELL TO THE RIG FLOOR, SUSTAINING SEVERE INTERNAL INJURIES, AND DIED BEFORE REACHING THE HOSPITAL.
rationale: The affected worker used a ladder climbing device to reach the derrick work area and subsequently fell while working there; the ladder branch suffices.
confirmation_rationale: The ladder-access alternative is explicitly performed to reach the derrick work area; the later fall was fatal. No tree climbing is asserted.

historical_description: Move levers or controls that operate lifting devices, such as forklifts, lift beams with swivel-hooks, hoists, or elevating platforms, to load, unload, transport, or stack material.
official_description: Move levers or controls that operate lifting devices, such as forklifts, lift beams with swivel-hooks, hoists, or elevating platforms, to load, unload, transport, or stack material.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE WAS OPERATING A CATERPILLAR ROUGH TERRAIN INDUSTRIAL FORKLIFT TRUCK (MODEL NUMBER R-80) TO MOVE WOOD ROOF TRUSSES TO THE TRUCK LOADING AREA OF A PLANT.
incident_quote: APPARENTLY, THE OPERATOR TRIED TO EXIT THE TRUCK AND WAS ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: The affected operator extended and maneuvered a forklift carrying roof trusses to a loading area; the mast contacted a power line. Report 14241830 is empty.
confirmation_rationale: The forklift operator extended its mast and maneuvered roof trusses to a loading area; contact with a power line electrocuted him. Actual controls operation is established by those movements.

historical_description: Work on high ceilings, using scaffolding or other tools, such as stilts.
official_description: Work on high ceilings, using scaffolding or other tools, such as stilts.
activity_quote: Employees #1 and #2 were spray painting a gymnasium ceiling 20 ft 8 in. above the wood floor from a manually-propelled mobile scaffold.
incident_quote: The scaffold rolled, tilted, and fell to the floor.
rationale: Victims spray-painted high gymnasium ceiling from mobile scaffold that overturned.
confirmation_rationale: Both employees painted a high gymnasium ceiling from a mobile scaffold; scaffold collapse killed one and injured the other.

historical_description: Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
official_description: Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
activity_quote: Employee #1, a field worker on a crew, was harvesting tomatoes in the #1 row, which was right next to the field harvesting tractor and trailer.
incident_quote: When his coworkers arrived at the trailer to dump their buckets of tomatoes, they found Employee #1 under the tandem rear wheels of the harvesting trailer. He had been run over and killed.
rationale: The field worker harvested tomatoes alongside coworkers carrying hand-filled buckets to a trailer; hand harvest is supported by this workflow and he was run over in the row.
confirmation_rationale: The field worker harvested tomatoes alongside coworkers collecting them in buckets, supporting hand harvesting in context. He was run over by the harvesting trailer.

historical_description: Perform or assist with cleaning duties as necessary.
official_description: Perform or assist with cleaning duties as necessary.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was performing his normal duties of cleaning up sawdust and wood chips.
incident_quote: Employee #1's right arm was amputated up to the elbow, his left arm was broken in several places, and he suffered four broken vertebrae.
rationale: The affected employee cleaned sawdust and wood chips and was pulled into the waste conveyor drive.
confirmation_rationale: Cleaning sawdust and chips is explicit; the worker was pulled into the chip conveyor while cleaning under the mill.

historical_description: Set charges of explosives to split rock.
official_description: Set charges of explosives to split rock.
activity_quote: TWO EMPLOYEES WERE LOADING UNIGEL EXPLOSIVE INTO 3 1/2 INCH DIAMETER HOLE, 18 FEET DEEP.
incident_quote: THE BLASTER AND HIS HELPER WERE SPRAYED WITH DIRT AND PIECES OF ROCK. BOTH EMPLOYEES WENT TO THE HOSPITAL.
rationale: A blaster and helper loaded explosive charges into a drilled rock-hole pattern and struck an obstruction near the charge, causing the premature rock-blasting explosion.
confirmation_rationale: Primed explosive charges were placed in drilled rock holes; an explosion during placement/clearing injured the blaster and helper. The rock-splitting purpose follows from the blast-hole pattern and rock context.

historical_description: Load or unload trucks that deliver or pick up food or supplies.
official_description: Load or unload trucks that deliver or pick up food or supplies.
activity_quote: A TRUCK DRIVER WAS UNLOADING MEAT FROM HIS TRUCK ONTO THE HYDRAULIC LIFT PLATFORM.
incident_quote: HE HAD BEEN CRUSHED BETWEEN THE BOTTOM OF THE LIFT PLATFORM AND THE GROUND.
rationale: The truck driver unloaded meat using a hydraulic platform and lowered it onto the worker cleaning underneath, directly involving food-truck unloading.
confirmation_rationale: The driver unloaded meat from the truck and lowered the hydraulic platform onto a worker cleaning below. Food-truck unloading by another worker directly involved the victim.

historical_description: Guide workpieces against saws, saw over workpieces by hand, or operate automatic feeding devices to guide cuts.
official_description: Guide workpieces against saws, saw over workpieces by hand, or operate automatic feeding devices to guide cuts.
activity_quote: Employee #1 attempted to feed two pieces of slick plastic, one piece on top of the other piece, into the saw.
incident_quote: his right finger was drawn into the moving saw blade.
rationale: Victim fed plastic workpieces into table saw; binding drew finger into blade.
confirmation_rationale: The operator fed plastic pieces into the saw; his finger was drawn into its blade. This is the guide-workpieces-against-saws alternative.

historical_description: Dig trenches for underground wires or cables.
official_description: Dig trenches for underground wires or cables.
activity_quote: THE EMPLOYEES WERE USING A BACKHOE TO LOOK FOR A BURIED ELECTRICAL CABLE.
incident_quote: THE FOREMAN, WHO WAS CROUCHED OVER LOOKING FOR THE I .D. RIBBON, WAS STRUCK IN THE HEAD BY THE BUCKET.
rationale: The crew excavated a trench to expose a buried electrical cable; the backhoe bucket directly struck the foreman assisting in locating it. Report 869404 is empty.
confirmation_rationale: The backhoe actually excavated a trench to locate an underground cable and its returning bucket struck the foreman. Cable-related trench digging is supported, without asserting new cable installation.

historical_description: Operate conveyors and equipment to transfer grain or other materials from transportation vehicles.
official_description: Operate conveyors and equipment to transfer grain or other materials from transportation vehicles.
activity_quote: A FOURTH EMPLOYEE WAS OPERATING A CONVEYOR, SWINGING IT IN A NORTHEASTERLY DIRECTION.
incident_quote: THE CONVEYOR HAD CONTACTED THE POWER LINE. ONE OF THE EMPLOYEES, WHO HAD BEEN STANDING ON THE TRUCK BED, WAS ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: Worker operated conveyor to unload delivered roofing tile and contacted power line, electrocuting worker on truck bed.
confirmation_rationale: The delivered roofing load, helpers strapping tile, and actual operation/swinging of the conveyor support its unloading purpose in context. The conveyor contacted the line and electrocuted a worker on the truck. Actual material travel on the conveyor is not separately described; this contextual-purpose interpretation should remain visible.

historical_description: Cut or drill holes in walls or floors to accommodate the passage of pipes.
official_description: Cut or drill holes in walls or floors to accommodate the passage of pipes.
activity_quote: He was opening an 8 in. wide hole in the inside wall of a manhole to install a sanitary pipe.
incident_quote: He suffered a fractured skull and multiple fractures to other parts of his body. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: The plumber was opening a hole in a manhole wall for a sanitary pipe when the trench collapsed.
confirmation_rationale: The plumber opened a hole in a manhole wall to install a sanitary pipe; the surrounding trench collapsed during that task and killed him.

historical_description: Work with or remove hazardous material.
official_description: Work with or remove hazardous material.
activity_quote: They were using a flammable lacquer thinner, a combustible stripper, rags soaked in these chemicals, and an electric sander to remove a stain finish.
incident_quote: One of them suffered first and second degree burns on his lower legs.
rationale: The injured workers used flammable thinner and combustible stripper to remove a finish and were burned during ignition.
confirmation_rationale: Actual use of flammable thinner and stripper for finish removal is explicit. Ignition during the work caused burns and escape through a window.

historical_description: Operate slicing or wrapping machines.
official_description: Operate slicing or wrapping machines.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 USED HIS LEFT HAND TO JOG THE MACHINE WHILE PUSHING THE PRODUCT WITH HIS RIGHT HAND.
incident_quote: THE THIRD AND FOURTH FINGERS OF HIS RIGHT HAND WERE CAUGHT BY THE FIRST ROTATING CRIMPER HEAD AND THE FINGERTIPS AMPUTATED.
rationale: The injured operator jogged a cheese-slice wrapping machine to thread plastic and caught his fingers in the crimper.
confirmation_rationale: The operator actually jogged the cheese-wrapping machine while threading/feeding it; rotating crimpers amputated fingertips.

historical_description: Lower irons, rams, or pressing heads of machines into position over material to be pressed.
official_description: Lower irons, rams, or pressing heads of machines into position over material to be pressed.
activity_quote: Employee #1 had used the foot trip to activate the press brake.
incident_quote: His right index finger was amputated.
rationale: Victim activated press-brake foot trip to bend metal, lowering forming blade over workpiece; hand entered point of operation and finger amputated.
confirmation_rationale: The worker activated a press brake by foot trip while bending metal; the forming action amputated his finger. This supports lowering a pressing head over material.

historical_description: Operate heavy equipment, such as bulldozers and front-end loaders.
official_description: Operate heavy equipment, such as bulldozers and front-end loaders.
activity_quote: The loader operator, employed by a subcontractor, applied the wrong brakes.
incident_quote: The front end bucket pivoted, pinning Employee #1 between it and a parked dump truck.
rationale: Loader operator applied wrong brakes during grading, pivoting bucket into nearby superintendent.
confirmation_rationale: The loader was actively grading and its operator applied the wrong brakes; the bucket pivoted and fatally pinned the superintendent.

historical_description: Maintain production equipment and machinery.
official_description: Maintain production equipment and machinery.
activity_quote: An employee was performing maintenance on equipment at a cannery. As he was replacing a leaky steam regulator valve gasket, he was scalded by hot water that had not been drained from the body of the valve.
incident_quote: The employee was hospitalized for less than a day and treated for a second-degree burn to the back of his neck.
rationale: The cannery employee replaced a leaking steam-regulator gasket as equipment maintenance and was scalded.
confirmation_rationale: A stronger source explicitly states maintenance with machinery locked out on an industrial cooker; rotating its shaft with channel locks amputated part of a finger. This supports production-equipment maintenance.

historical_description: Erect scaffolding or other installation structures.
official_description: Erect scaffolding or other installation structures.
activity_quote: Employee #1, a carpenter foreman for Ceco Corp., was setting up temporary forms and decking for poured reinforced concrete.
incident_quote: The employee fell 19 ft through the opening to a concrete deck and died of massive head injuries.
rationale: The carpenter erected temporary forms and decking supported by scaffolding for concrete placement and fell through a failed pour strip. One report is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Setting up temporary concrete forms and decking with scaffold shoring supports the other-installation-structures alternative; a decking strip failed and the worker fell fatally.

historical_description: Load, unload, or adjust materials or products on conveyors by hand, by using lifts, hoists, and scoops, or by opening gates, chutes, or hoppers.
official_description: Load, unload, or adjust materials or products on conveyors by hand, by using lifts, hoists, and scoops, or by opening gates, chutes, or hoppers.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was arranging a piece of material on a powered conveyor

historical_description: Monitor equipment to ensure proper operation.
official_description: Monitor equipment to ensure proper operation.

confirmation_rationale: The operator explicitly inspects the running equipment with its guard open. This guard-open operating condition and incomplete run-down directly expose the assisting worker who reaches in after the operator stops and leaves.

historical_description: Receive, unload, open, unpack, or issue sales floor merchandise.

confirmation_rationale: Removing frozen merchandise from storage for replenishment of sales-floor display cases is explicit. The employee falls from the access ladder during that task.

historical_description: Inspect machinery to determine whether repairs are needed.

confirmation_rationale: The mechanic inspects moving trolley wheels while troubleshooting abnormal flange wear. His viewing position exposes him to fatal crushing between the moving trolley and fixed guard.

historical_description: Perform equipment maintenance, such as cleaning tanks and lubricating moving parts of conveyors.
official_description: Perform equipment maintenance, such as cleaning tanks and lubricating moving parts of conveyors.

confirmation_rationale: Conveyor maintenance through lubrication of bands is explicit; the lubricating rag pulls the index finger into an opening.

historical_description: Turn valves to pump sterilizing solutions or rinse water through pipes or equipment or to spray vats with atomizers.
official_description: Turn valves to pump sterilizing solutions or rinse water through pipes or equipment or to spray vats with atomizers.

confirmation_rationale: The worker activates a pump and opens a ball valve conveying acid sanitizer into a tank; the valve ruptures and sprays his eyes and face.

historical_description: File or finish surfaces of workpieces, using prescribed hand tools.
official_description: File or finish surfaces of workpieces, using prescribed hand tools.

confirmation_rationale: The employee manually smooths a drive-shaft end using emery cloth on a lathe; a glove entangles and breaks his arm. This establishes surface finishing with a manual abrasive.

historical_description: Position and hold timbers, lumber, or paneling in place for fastening or cutting.
official_description: Position and hold timbers, lumber, or paneling in place for fastening or cutting.

confirmation_rationale: Holding and positioning lumber to measurement for the saw cut is explicit; actuation clamps the guard and raises the blade through his fingers.

historical_description: Cut or drill holes in floors, walls, or roof to install equipment, using power saws or drills.
official_description: Cut or drill holes in floors, walls, or roof to install equipment, using power saws or drills.

confirmation_rationale: Battery-powered roof-deck cutting for HVAC installation is explicit. After fetching a battery the employee falls through the very cut being made, directly linking this equipment-installation opening to the injury.

historical_description: Secure cargo for transport, using ropes, blocks, chain, binders, or covers.
official_description: Secure cargo for transport, using ropes, blocks, chain, binders, or covers.

confirmation_rationale: Chain-and-binder securing of the truck load is explicit. The binder from that secured load collapses onto the driver during his final inspection.

historical_description: Slice fruits, vegetables, desserts, or meats for use in food service.
official_description: Slice fruits, vegetables, desserts, or meats for use in food service.

confirmation_rationale: The cook cuts tomatoes into small pieces for sauce using a powered chopper; residual blade rotation amputates a finger while he clears remaining tomato immediately after processing.

historical_description: Inspect loads to ensure that cargo is secure.
official_description: Inspect loads to ensure that cargo is secure.

confirmation_rationale: The driver stops for the required cargo-security check and releases securing straps; the unsecured glass falls and kills him. The report does not explain why he released them.

historical_description: Mount, balance, change, or check condition or pressure of tires.
official_description: Mount, balance, change, or check condition or pressure of tires.

confirmation_rationale: The employee checks truck-tire pressure with a gauge while inflating and releasing air; the tire explodes immediately after the final check.

historical_description: Mount and bolt sawing blades or attachments to machine shafts.

confirmation_rationale: Employees explicitly install and bolt a replacement saw blade with a damaged arbor bolt. Its subsequent loosening releases the blade into the operator face, directly implicating the mounting task.

historical_description: Rework, repair, or replace damaged parts or assemblies.
official_description: Rework, repair, or replace damaged parts or assemblies.

confirmation_rationale: Reworking a bend on a manufactured part using the press brake is explicit; the repeated bend pinches and partially amputates the thumb.

historical_description: Operate power-driven pumps that transfer liquids, semi-liquids, gases, or powdered materials.

confirmation_rationale: Electric drum-pump transfer of concentrated nitric acid is explicit and results in chemical burns.

historical_description: Attach rigging and signal crane or hoist operators to lift heavy frame and plate sections or other parts into place.
official_description: Attach rigging and signal crane or hoist operators to lift heavy frame and plate sections or other parts into place.

historical_description: Examine systems to locate problems, such as loose connections or broken insulation.

confirmation_rationale: Employees rack out and examine the breaker to locate the failure to close. Racking it back after this diagnostic examination produces the injurious arc.

historical_description: Lift equipment into position, using cranes and rigging tools or equipment, such as gin poles.
official_description: Lift equipment into position, using cranes and rigging tools or equipment, such as gin poles.

confirmation_rationale: A gin-pole truck and rigging lift a trailer into loading position during repeated attempts. The rigging falls onto the employee directing the lifting operation.

historical_description: Identify environmental contamination sources.
official_description: Identify environmental contamination sources.

rationale: Worker sampled tank water to determine contamination; diesel was found and he suffered myocardial infarction attributed to petroleum vapors during the sampling entry.
confirmation_rationale: The worker enters the tank and actually takes water samples to identify contamination; illness following exposure is diagnosed in the narrative as petroleum-vapor-associated myocardial infarction, and samples reveal diesel.

historical_description: Maintain equipment, making repairs or modifications when necessary.
official_description: Maintain equipment, making repairs or modifications when necessary.

incident_quote: As a result, the employee sustained a fractured hip.
rationale: Worker repaired a disconnected trailer door by rehanging it, then fell while maneuvering it; conditional repairs are directly demonstrated.
confirmation_rationale: Repairing the disconnected trailer door by rehanging it is explicit; the worker falls while maneuvering it from stacked pallets.

historical_description: Remove litter and debris from roadways, including debris from rock and mud slides.
official_description: Remove litter and debris from roadways, including debris from rock and mud slides.

confirmation_rationale: The worker removes road debris on foot in the highway lane and is struck and killed by a vehicle.

historical_description: Operate gluing machines to glue pieces of wood together, or to press and affix wood veneer to wood surfaces.
official_description: Operate gluing machines to glue pieces of wood together, or to press and affix wood veneer to wood surfaces.

incident_quote: amputating Employee #1's right pinky finger as it was pinched between the chain assembly and the machines deck.

confirmation_rationale: Operation of a lumber-gluing press and its automated feed are explicit. The assistant is injured correcting a misfeed when the automatic feed rises despite the stop button.

historical_description: Collaborate with other operators to solve unit problems.
official_description: Collaborate with other operators to solve unit problems.

incident_quote: Employees #1 and #2, two unprotected operators who responded to incident, were brought to Long Beach Memorial Hospital to be treated for inhalation of hydrocarbons.
rationale: Unit operators jointly suppressed and isolated a leaking coker pump; two participating operators suffered hydrocarbon inhalation. This directly establishes collaboration to solve a unit problem.
confirmation_rationale: Several unit operators explicitly respond together to solve a leaking pump problem by suppression, shutdown and isolation. Two participating operators inhale hydrocarbons from that leak.

historical_description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to saw, cut, shear, slit, punch, crimp, notch, bend, or straighten metal or plastic material.
official_description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to saw, cut, shear, slit, punch, crimp, notch, bend, or straighten metal or plastic material.

rationale: The injured employee operated a mechanical shear to cut metal plate, directly satisfying one alternative action and material branch.
confirmation_rationale: Operation of a mechanical shear to cut a metal gusset is explicit; the cut piece falls onto the operator finger.

historical_description: Participate in required job training.
official_description: Participate in required job training.

confirmation_rationale: Required police-academy physical training is explicit and completed immediately before collapse. Extreme core temperature, weather conditions and lack of water breaks directly connect the reported fatal event to training exposure without asserting a more specific medical cause.

official_description: Maintain a supply of packing materials.

confirmation_rationale: Obtaining a carton of packing boxes from the transfer-station pallet supplies the active orange-packing operation; the employee falls through the supply-transfer opening during retrieval.

historical_description: Provide assistance to skilled roofers installing and repairing roofs, flashings, and surfaces.
official_description: Provide assistance to skilled roofers installing and repairing roofs, flashings, and surfaces.

confirmation_rationale: A roofing laborer explicitly assists flashing repair through removal and material handling. The carried flashing contacts a power line and causes burns and a fall.

historical_description: Unscrew or tighten pipes, casing, tubing, and pump rods, using hand and power wrenches and tongs.
official_description: Unscrew or tighten pipes, casing, tubing, and pump rods, using hand and power wrenches and tongs.

confirmation_rationale: The worker explicitly uses two pipe wrenches to tighten overhead pipe fittings; wrench slippage causes the injurious fall.

historical_description: Set up or inspect equipment prior to operation.

confirmation_rationale: Equipment inspection after sanitation and before production is explicit, although powered for the inspection. Clearing the discovered food residue exposes the finger to rotating paddles.

historical_description: Transplant and remove trees and shrubs, and prepare trees for moving.
official_description: Transplant and remove trees and shrubs, and prepare trees for moving.

confirmation_rationale: Relocating trees and attaching rigging to prepare them for moving are explicit. Repositioning the loader to reach the treetop results in boom movement that crushes the foreman.

historical_description: Use knives, cleavers, meat saws, bandsaws, or other equipment to perform meat cutting and trimming.
official_description: Use knives, cleavers, meat saws, bandsaws, or other equipment to perform meat cutting and trimming.

incident_quote: His left index finger was amputated.
rationale: The butcher uses a specified meat bandsaw to cut meat into small strips, directly exposing his hand to the blade.
confirmation_rationale: Meat cutting with the specified bandsaw is explicit; the butcher finger contacts the running blade during cutting.

historical_description: Direct traffic movement or warn of hazards, using signs, flags, lanterns, and hand signals.
official_description: Direct traffic movement or warn of hazards, using signs, flags, lanterns, and hand signals.

rationale: The injured employee placed traffic-control warning signs from a moving truck, directly performing the hazard-warning branch of this task.
confirmation_rationale: Placement of traffic-warning signs is explicitly occurring when the worker falls from the moving truck and sustains fatal injuries.

historical_description: Operate or tend automatic stacking, loading, packaging, or cutting machines.
official_description: Operate or tend automatic stacking, loading, packaging, or cutting machines.

incident_quote: The clamp squeezed down on the sides of his head, fracturing his jaw and lacerating his chin and ear.
rationale: The employee operated an explicitly automatic block stacking/palletizing machine and was caught while tending it by placing tags.
confirmation_rationale: An automatic cuber stacks and palletizes blocks while its operator places tags. The machine cycles and clamps his head.

historical_description: Move heavy furniture, equipment, or supplies, either manually or with hand trucks.
official_description: Move heavy furniture, equipment, or supplies, either manually or with hand trucks.

rationale: Two workers manually move a heavy machine and it falls onto the pushing worker; the specified manual heavy-equipment movement is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: Two workers manually move a 250-pound machine; it overturns during pushing and pulling and kills one of them.

historical_description: Raise trucks, buses, and heavy parts or equipment using hydraulic jacks or hoists.
official_description: Raise trucks, buses, and heavy parts or equipment using hydraulic jacks or hoists.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 PROCEEDED TO RAISE THE CAR UP AGAIN BY THE MOTOR
incident_quote: THE UNSUPPORTED FRAME OF THE CAR CRASH ED DOWN UPON HIS HEAD.

confirmation_rationale: The worker uses a truck-mounted hoist and slings to raise the heavy engine and attached car for removal. Cutting the remaining mount releases the unsupported frame onto his head while the engine remains suspended.

historical_description: Test machines to determine proper functioning.
official_description: Test machines to determine proper functioning.

incident_quote: Employee #1's fingers were immediately caught and crushed in the unguarded "pinch point" belt and pulley system.
rationale: The assembler performed the final systemic functioning check of a mechanical synchronizer, adjusting its motion under test load when stored energy crushed his fingers.
confirmation_rationale: A final functional check of a mechanical synchronizer before sale is explicit; readjustment under the test weight releases stored energy and crushes fingers.

historical_description: Mix acids, chemicals, or dry cement as required for a specific job.
official_description: Mix acids, chemicals, or dry cement as required for a specific job.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained chemical burns to his face and eyes, and was hospitalized.
rationale: The worker mixes a chemical powder with water to finish a specific filter-cleaning job; the mixing directly causes chemical burns.
confirmation_rationale: Mixing sodium-hydroxide powder with water to complete the filter-cleaning job is explicit; splashing causes face and eye burns.

historical_description: Mix cleaning compounds or solutions.
official_description: Mix cleaning compounds or solutions.

incident_quote: the employee suffered acute exposure to chlorine gas and was hospitalized

confirmation_rationale: Starting the cleaning system pumps cleaning chemicals into its mix tank. Incorrectly connected supply lines introduce incompatible chemicals and expose workers to chlorine gas during this mixing.

historical_description: Remove and replace cracked or damaged tile.
official_description: Remove and replace cracked or damaged tile.

incident_quote: Employee #1 was hospitalized with a broken right ankle.
rationale: The worker is replacing an explicitly water-damaged ceiling tile and falls while removing its wedged piece.
confirmation_rationale: Replacement of a water-damaged ceiling tile is explicit; the employee falls while removing and passing its wedged fragment.

historical_description: Weld components in flat, vertical, or overhead positions.
official_description: Weld components in flat, vertical, or overhead positions.
activity_quote: He was engaged in overhead welding of the outside of a booth.
incident_quote: His shirts ignited.
rationale: The affected employee explicitly performed overhead welding on a booth; falling welding ignition sources ignited his clothing and burned him.
confirmation_rationale: Overhead welding of the booth is explicit; hot welding material ignites clothing and causes hospitalized burns.

historical_description: Clean and clear debris from culverts, catch basins, drop inlets, ditches, and other drain structures.
official_description: Clean and clear debris from culverts, catch basins, drop inlets, ditches, and other drain structures.

incident_quote: Employee #1 was pronounced dead, and Employee #2 was put on life support.
rationale: The worker uses a pressure hose to clear accumulated debris from a storm drain shaft and is overcome by hydrogen sulfide during that cleaning task.
confirmation_rationale: Pressure-hose clearing of the clogged storm drain is explicit. The cleaner is overcome in the shaft and dies, and an attempted rescuer is also overcome.

historical_description: Test machinery to ensure proper functioning before beginning production.
official_description: Test machinery to ensure proper functioning before beginning production.

rationale: The employee tests an actuated valve intended for installation in production, checking operating direction; the valve cycles onto his fingers during the test.
confirmation_rationale: The worker explicitly tests valve direction before the assembly is installed in production; the valve cycles onto his fingers.

historical_description: Drive pilings to provide support for buildings or other structures, using heavy equipment with a pile driver head.
official_description: Drive pilings to provide support for buildings or other structures, using heavy equipment with a pile driver head.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was operating a pile-driving American crane when the concrete piling failed, breaking at ground level.
incident_quote: The piling and pile driver equipment swung in to the outside part of the crane cab, striking Employee #1
rationale: A crane operator drives concrete pilings with pile-driving equipment; the piling breaks during operation and the suspended equipment strikes and kills him.
confirmation_rationale: Operation of a pile-driving crane on a concrete piling is explicit. Piling failure swings it and the driver equipment into the crane operator, killing him.

historical_description: Stop equipment or machinery and clear jams, using poles, bars, and hand tools, or remove damaged materials from conveyors.
official_description: Stop equipment or machinery and clear jams, using poles, bars, and hand tools, or remove damaged materials from conveyors.
adjudication_rationale: Accept the independent or branch: removing a broken wood splinter from the conveyor bridge matches removal of damaged material. Stopping machinery and use of tools qualify the first branch, not the independent removal branch.
activity_quote: A splinter jammed into the bridge and the employee reached over to remove it when his finger was caught between the bridge and belt conveyor.
incident_quote: The employee suffered a fingertip amputation and was treated without hospitalization.
rationale: Accept the independent or branch: removing a broken wood splinter from the conveyor bridge matches removal of damaged material. Stopping machinery and use of tools qualify the first branch, not the independent removal branch.
confirmation_rationale: The selected incident establishes removal of a splinter jam by hand, not stopping the conveyor and using a tool. Assigned removal of bad lumber is a general duty, not the observed incident action. Other examples likewise lack the combined stop-and-tool conditions, including bar use on a running conveyor; preserve core jam clearing as partial support.

historical_description: Operate machines or equipment to remove, package, store, or transport loads of waste materials.
official_description: Operate machines or equipment to remove, package, store, or transport loads of waste materials.
activity_quote: Employee #1 proceeded to lift a waste can using the side load hoist and emptied the contents of the can into a hopper.
incident_quote: The sweeper blade now engaged, came in contact with both the left and right of the employee's legs.
rationale: The employee operated a side-loading waste collection truck, emptying a waste can before a hoist stoppage led to the directly related troubleshooting injury.
confirmation_rationale: The worker operates the side-loading waste truck to empty a can into the hopper. Investigation of the interrupted lift cycle results in a fall into the same powered waste-handling mechanism.

historical_description: Signal workers to start geological material extraction or boring.
official_description: Signal workers to start geological material extraction or boring.
activity_quote: Coworker #1, a foreman, instructed the boring operator to initiate boring
incident_quote: Employee #1 was struck in the back of the head by the pipe tong attached to the stem.
rationale: The foreman instructs the operator to initiate geological boring, directly causing rotation of the stem and the fatal pipe-tong strike.
confirmation_rationale: The foreman explicitly instructs the operator to initiate boring before the drill-stem area is cleared. The resulting movement swings the attached tong into the affected worker head.

historical_description: Install, inspect, clean, or repair piping or valves.
official_description: Install, inspect, clean, or repair piping or valves.

confirmation_rationale: The employee is explicitly installing tank piping and falls while retrieving its parts on a ladder during that ongoing task.

historical_description: Operate farm machinery, including tractors, plows, mowers, combines, balers, sprayers, earthmoving equipment, or trucks.

historical_description: Fill processing or cooking containers, such as kettles, rotating cookers, pressure cookers, or vats, with ingredients, by opening valves, by starting pumps or injectors, or by hand.

historical_description: Clean and maintain extruding and forming machines, using hand tools.

confirmation_rationale: A screwdriver is explicitly used to remove accumulated plastic from extrusion equipment; contact with its blade causes a hand cut and then head injury.

historical_description: Perform general warehouse activities, such as opening containers and crates, filling warehouse orders, assisting in taking inventory, and weighing and checking materials.
official_description: Perform general warehouse activities, such as opening containers and crates, filling warehouse orders, assisting in taking inventory, and weighing and checking materials.

confirmation_rationale: The warehouse worker collects material to fill an order, one of the expressly listed warehouse activities, and is struck by a powered picker while doing so.

historical_description: Move or position materials such as marble slabs, using cranes, hoists, or dollies.

historical_description: Thread and hand-feed materials through machine cutters or abraders.

official_description: Operate or tend machines to mix or blend any of a wide variety of materials, such as spices, dough batter, tobacco, fruit juices, chemicals, livestock feed, food products, color pigments, or explosive ingredients.

historical_description: Drive trucks to deliver such items as food, medical supplies, or newspapers.

confirmation_rationale: The temporary worker explicitly assists the shop mechanic with forklift oil-filter replacement; the supported vehicle falls off its jack and kills him.

official_description: Operate equipment, such as excavators, backhoes, rock hammers, trench compactors, pavement saws, grout mixers or pumps, geothermal loop reels, and coil tubing units (CTU).
