activity_quote: In order to correct the issue, the maintenance employee had to lubricate bushings.
incident_quote: the assembler portion of the machine cycled and caught his hand, resulting in several fractures and a puncture wound.
rationale: The maintenance worker lubricated bushings and adjusted gate timing to fix a feeding malfunction; clearing a shell during that maintenance injured his hand.
confirmation_rationale: The maintenance worker lubricates bushings and adjusts timing to correct a machine feeding malfunction. Clearing a trapped shell within that maintenance sequence cycles the machine onto his hand.

historical_description: Direct or perform mixing or application of fertilizers, insecticides, herbicides, or fungicides.
official_description: Direct or perform mixing or application of fertilizers, insecticides, herbicides, or fungicides.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was spraying a field with a mixture of herbicide and pesticide.
incident_quote: his upper body was sprayed with the mixture.
rationale: Worker applied herbicide/pesticide mixture to a field with a spraying rig; repairing a loose connection in that operation caused upper-body chemical exposure.
confirmation_rationale: The employee sprays herbicide/pesticide and receives a chemical spray exposure while repairing the application rig connection. This supports the exposure accident, but the medical examiner could not establish that it caused his later death.

historical_description: Fabricate or repair counters, benches, partitions, or other wooden structures, such as sheds or outbuildings.
official_description: Fabricate or repair counters, benches, partitions, or other wooden structures, such as sheds or outbuildings.
activity_quote: They erected a platform by using wooden planks from the scaffold system
incident_quote: The wooden platform detached from the wall nails/support, and the employees fell about 16 feet
rationale: Drywall crew fabricated a wooden plank working platform, an other wooden structure; its wall fastening failed during their work and all three fell.
confirmation_rationale: The employees construct a wooden work platform by nailing planks to the wall and resting them on scaffold rails. Those supports fail during subsequent use, injuring all three; the fabricated structure directly participates in the accident.

historical_description: Measure and mark guidelines on surfaces or foundations, using chalk lines and dividers.
official_description: Measure and mark guidelines on surfaces or foundations, using chalk lines and dividers.
activity_quote: The coworker was holding the box while Employee #1 was backing up north ward while pulling out the line.
incident_quote: He died a short time later from injuries sustained to his upper body and head.
rationale: The roofers laid out a chalk line on the roof, with one holding its box and the victim drawing the line as he fell.
confirmation_rationale: The roofers deploy a chalk line to mark the roof. Backing up while pulling the line sends the worker off the roof to fatal injuries.

historical_description: Apply weatherproof, decorative coverings to exterior surfaces of buildings, such as by troweling or spraying on coats of stucco.
official_description: Apply weatherproof, decorative coverings to exterior surfaces of buildings, such as by troweling or spraying on coats of stucco.
activity_quote: They were applying stucco to the side of the building from the third and second buck work platforms of a tubular welded frame scaffold.
incident_quote: The three employees fell, a fall height of 21 feet.
rationale: Workers applied exterior stucco from scaffold when forklift collision collapsed it; the stated decorative exterior covering activity is directly established.
confirmation_rationale: The crew applies exterior stucco from scaffold platforms. A supplying forklift strikes the scaffold, causing collapse and fall injuries during application.

historical_description: Assist customers, such as responding to customer complaints and updating them about back-ordered parts.
official_description: Assist customers, such as responding to customer complaints and updating them about back-ordered parts.
activity_quote: was retrieving parts for a customer in the store's backroom.
incident_quote: he fell and struck his head on the floor.
rationale: Auto-parts employee assisted a customer by retrieving requested parts, an example of customer assistance; he fell from the retrieval ladder.
confirmation_rationale: The employee assists a customer by retrieving auto parts. He falls from the retrieval ladder and is hospitalized; the report also identifies intoxication.

historical_description: Turn valves to regulate flow of products or byproducts through agitator tanks, storage drums, or neutralizer tanks.
official_description: Turn valves to regulate flow of products or byproducts through agitator tanks, storage drums, or neutralizer tanks.
activity_quote: He then turned the relief valve of the tank to bleed the vapor pressure into the drum.
incident_quote: spraying the employee's lower portion of his body with ammonia.
rationale: Worker turned the ammonia tank relief valve to direct vapor into a water-filled drum, functioning as a neutralizing vessel; the drum burst and sprayed him.
confirmation_rationale: The employee turns a tank relief valve to bleed ammonia vapor into a water drum. A blocked vent ruptures the drum and exposes him to ammonia burns and inhalation.

historical_description: Provide assistance to workers engaged in construction or extraction activities, using hand tools or other equipment.
official_description: Provide assistance to workers engaged in construction or extraction activities, using hand tools or other equipment.
activity_quote: an employee and a coworker were taking turns entering a previously excavated trench to do a final hand dig to find a sewer pipe. A spade shovel was being used for this task.
incident_quote: The employee was killed from asphyxiation.
rationale: The worker shared final trench hand excavation with a coworker, using a spade to expose the sewer pipe during construction.
confirmation_rationale: The employee assists trench work by taking turns hand digging with a spade to locate a sewer pipe. The trench collapses onto him immediately after locating it and kills him.

historical_description: Smooth or finish freshly poured cement or concrete, using floats, trowels, screeds, or powered cement finishing tools.
official_description: Smooth or finish freshly poured cement or concrete, using floats, trowels, screeds, or powered cement finishing tools.
activity_quote: A concrete finisher was using a float with a 10-meter-long aluminum handle to finish concrete.
incident_quote: The employee received an electric shock and burns to his hands and right thigh.
rationale: The injured finisher explicitly used a float to finish concrete; its long handle contacted the power line.
confirmation_rationale: Concrete finishing with an aluminum-handled float is explicit. The handle contacts a power line and shocks/burns the finisher.

historical_description: Trim, sand, or scrape surfaces or joints to prepare articles for finishing.
official_description: Trim, sand, or scrape surfaces or joints to prepare articles for finishing.
activity_quote: was per forming preparatory works sanding, scuffing, and scrapping before painting.
incident_quote: Employee #1 suffered fractures to his leg and back.
rationale: The laborer sanded, scuffed and scraped the crane jib as preparation for painting when it crushed him.
confirmation_rationale: The laborer explicitly sands, scuffs and scrapes before painting. The crane jib being prepared crushes him against the floor, fracturing his leg and back.

historical_description: Conduct general housekeeping of units, including wiping up oil spills and performing general cleaning duties.
official_description: Conduct general housekeeping of units, including wiping up oil spills and performing general cleaning duties.
activity_quote: the employee drained hot water from the tank to help remove oil residue on the floor.
incident_quote: releasing hot water that splashed onto the employee's body.
rationale: Food-processing worker cleaned a tank and used its drained hot water to remove floor oil residue; hot water released onto him during the cleaning.
confirmation_rationale: The employee drains hot tank water to clean oil residue from the floor. A rotating elbow releases that water onto his body and burns him.

historical_description: Maintain or repair engines, electric motors, pumps, winches, or other mechanical or electrical equipment, or assist other crew members with maintenance or repair duties.
official_description: Maintain or repair engines, electric motors, pumps, winches, or other mechanical or electrical equipment, or assist other crew members with maintenance or repair duties.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was performing maintenance work on equipment used to make ignition caps for automotive air bags.
incident_quote: Flames flashed up the sleeve of Employee #1's smock and he sustained third-degree burns to his arm.
rationale: The employee dismantled and reassembled ignition-cap equipment during maintenance, causing ignition while forcing a misaligned screw.
confirmation_rationale: The employee dismantles and reassembles ignition-cap equipment during maintenance. Forcing a screw into an inverted component ignites residue and burns his arm; authorization is not necessary for activity presence.

historical_description: Start machines and observe mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
official_description: Start machines and observe mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
activity_quote: He shut off the machine to adjust the guide rail, then turned the machine back on to observe its operation.
incident_quote: The tip of his little finger was amputated below the nail.
rationale: The mechanic restarted the seamer, observed unsmooth running and made another adjustment when injured.
confirmation_rationale: The repairer restarts the seamer specifically to observe its operation. He then makes a final adjustment during that running test and catches his finger between its parts.

historical_description: Control or operate chemical processes or systems of machines, using panelboards, control boards, or semi-automatic equipment.
official_description: Control or operate chemical processes or systems of machines, using panelboards, control boards, or semi-automatic equipment.
activity_quote: they added the catalyst to the mini -batch as directed.
incident_quote: Employees #1 and #2 were burned to death.
rationale: The board operator controlled a reactor mini-batch and added catalyst according to a changed recipe, directly initiating the runaway reaction.
confirmation_rationale: Board and outside operators manually control reactor startup and add catalyst under changed instructions. The incorrectly charged batch runs away and explodes, killing nearby workers and burning the outside operator.

historical_description: Move or reposition hoists, winches, loads and materials, manually or using equipment and machines such as trucks, cars, and hand trucks.
official_description: Move or reposition hoists, winches, loads and materials, manually or using equipment and machines such as trucks, cars, and hand trucks.
activity_quote: He attempted to hoist the storage unit onto his truck with the chain and the hook that was attached to the winch.
incident_quote: The chain flew off the container, hitting the driver in the head.
rationale: Driver used a winch to reposition a storage-unit load onto his truck; the chain struck his head during the movement.
confirmation_rationale: The driver uses a winch and chain to hoist a storage unit onto his truck. The chain comes free and fractures his skull.

historical_description: Observe air and temperature gauges or metal color and fluidity, and turn fuel valves or adjust controls to maintain required temperatures.
official_description: Observe air and temperature gauges or metal color and fluidity, and turn fuel valves or adjust controls to maintain required temperatures.
activity_quote: The control operator then began to cut back on the temperature, 10 degrees at a time, trying to close the valves and put less gas into the heater.
incident_quote: Employee #1, who was at the heater checking out the problem, received second- and third-degree burns over 50 percent of his body.
rationale: Control operator observed falling temperature readings and adjusted controls/gas valves to regulate heater temperature during the developing explosion.
confirmation_rationale: The board operator observes pressure/temperature indicators and adjusts fuel controls to reduce gas input. The heater explodes before valve closure, fatally burning the field operator checking the same process.

historical_description: Cut, thread, or hammer pipes to specifications, using tools such as saws, cutting torches, pipe threaders, or pipe benders.
official_description: Cut, thread, or hammer pipes to specifications, using tools such as saws, cutting torches, pipe threaders, or pipe benders.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was assigned the task of operating an electrical conduit threading machine, a Ridgid Model Number 300 (an electrically-powered pipe threader).
incident_quote: The clamps closed down on Employee #1's fingers and amputated his left middle finger.
rationale: Worker operated a powered conduit pipe-threader and reached into it to check pipe position; rotating clamping jaws amputated his finger.
confirmation_rationale: The employee operates a powered pipe threader and inserts fingers to check pipe position while it rotates. The clamping jaws amputate his middle finger.

historical_description: Repair or replace wiring, equipment, or fixtures, using hand tools or power tools.
official_description: Repair or replace wiring, equipment, or fixtures, using hand tools or power tools.
activity_quote: SOME EMPLOYEES OF AN ELECTRICAL CONTRACTOR WERE REPLACING POLE-MOUNTED EQUIPMENT USING A HYDRAULIC TOOL.
incident_quote: THE HYDRAULIC FLUID CAUGHT FIRE, BURNING THREE EMPLOYEES.
rationale: Electrical workers explicitly replaced pole-mounted equipment using a hydraulic powered tool; tool hose caused electrical arc and fire.
confirmation_rationale: Electrical contractors replace pole-mounted equipment using a hydraulic tool. Its hose contacts/arcs a power line and burns three workers, one fatally.

historical_description: Prepare surfaces for insulation application by brushing or spreading on adhesives, cement, or asphalt, or by attaching metal pins to surfaces.
official_description: Prepare surfaces for insulation application by brushing or spreading on adhesives, cement, or asphalt, or by attaching metal pins to surfaces.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was inside a large section of HVAC duct applying Design Polymerics DP 2590 Duct Liner Spray Adhesive to repair sagging insulation.
incident_quote: While using the welder, a spark ignited flammable vapors from the adhesive, causing a flash fire inside the duct.
rationale: Worker applied duct-liner adhesive then attached insulation with a pin welder, explicitly establishing adhesive surface preparation and pin attachment; adhesive vapor ignited during this operation.
confirmation_rationale: The worker applies duct-liner adhesive and attaches insulation using a pin welder. The welder ignites the adhesive vapors and causes fatal burns, directly linking both preparation and attachment to the incident.

historical_description: Straighten, smooth, or shape materials to prepare them for pressing.
official_description: Straighten, smooth, or shape materials to prepare them for pressing.
activity_quote: ATTEMPTING TO STRAIGHTEN SOME MATERIAL BEING AUTOMATICALLY FED INTO THE PRESS.
incident_quote: HIS RIGHT HAND WAS PULLED UNDER THE POINT OF OPERATION GUARD ON THE RIGHT SIDE OF THE DIE AREA.
rationale: Worker straightened material feeding a press when the press caught his hand; the action and purpose are explicit.
confirmation_rationale: The worker straightens material feeding into the press. His hand is pulled into its point of operation and suffers severe finger lacerations.

historical_description: Sing or dance during dramatic or comedic performances.
official_description: Sing or dance during dramatic or comedic performances.
activity_quote: Employee #1 and a coworker were performing at a shopping mall with an aerial entertainment group.
incident_quote: She slipped and fell feet first, approximately 18 ft into the box
rationale: The aerial-ballet performer danced a choreographed performance when she fell from the hoop; source truncates after the fall but establishes the incident.
confirmation_rationale: A choreographed aerial ballet performance is dance in a staged entertainment production. The performer falls from the suspended hoop; the truncated account establishes the accident but supplies no final injury outcome.

historical_description: Perform minor repairs or routine maintenance on lighting equipment, such as replacing lamps or damaged color filters.
official_description: Perform minor repairs or routine maintenance on lighting equipment, such as replacing lamps or damaged color filters.
activity_quote: A maintenance employee was repairing a florescent lighting fixture in a rendering plant.
incident_quote: The maintenance worker was electrocuted when he contacted an energized conductor.
rationale: Maintenance worker explicitly repaired a fluorescent lighting fixture and contacted its energized conductor. Repair is established; examples of lamps/filters are illustrative.
confirmation_rationale: The maintenance worker repairs a fluorescent light fixture while its branch circuit remains energized. Contact with an energized conductor electrocutes him.

historical_description: Operate or tend automated assembling equipment, such as robotics and fixed automation equipment.
official_description: Operate or tend automated assembling equipment, such as robotics and fixed automation equipment.
activity_quote: an employee operated the automatic D&P rubber gasket line, including the carousel and line picking equipment.
incident_quote: The placement of her hand triggered the material-sensing eye, causing the picking arm to move in toward her, striking the finger.
rationale: Worker operated an automated gasket assembly line and reached to align a gasket at its robotic picking arm; her hand triggered the arm and finger amputation.
confirmation_rationale: The worker operates an automatic gasket assembly line. Reaching to align/retrieve a gasket triggers the robotic picker and amputates a finger.

historical_description: Replace existing antennas with new antennas as directed.
official_description: Replace existing antennas with new antennas as directed.
activity_quote: Two employees were replacing a damaged television antenna
incident_quote: The tower fell over intact with his coworker attached. The employee was seriously injured and died about 1 week later.
rationale: Workers removed the damaged antenna and hoisted its replacement during the tower job; the attached worker died when the tower fell. This establishes the antenna replacement activity.
confirmation_rationale: The crew removes an old television antenna and hoists a replacement mast. The supporting tower collapses with the installer attached during that replacement operation, causing fatal injuries.

historical_description: Set up and adjust machines and equipment.
official_description: Set up and adjust machines and equipment.
activity_quote: During set up procedures, Employee #1 placed his hand into the machine to position a pin located in the "slotter".
incident_quote: Employee #1's left finger was crushed between the pin and the slot
rationale: Machine operator positioned a slotter pin during setup, directly adjusting equipment; finger was crushed between the pin and slot.
confirmation_rationale: The operator positions a slotter pin during machine setup. His finger is crushed between the pin and slot and amputated.

historical_description: Repair or service heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems to improve efficiency, such as by changing filters, cleaning ducts, and refilling non-toxic refrigerants.
official_description: Repair or service heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems to improve efficiency, such as by changing filters, cleaning ducts, and refilling non-toxic refrigerants.
activity_quote: An employee was replacing the filter and vacuuming the duct system of a heating and cooling unit.
incident_quote: It contacted energized parts, and the employee received an electric shock.
rationale: The injured worker was actually changing a heating/cooling filter and vacuuming its ducts, expressly included HVAC servicing actions.
confirmation_rationale: Replacing the HVAC filter and vacuuming ducts matches the service examples. The vacuum handle contacts energized furnace parts and shocks the worker.

historical_description: Harvest marine life for human or animal consumption, using diving or dredging equipment, traps, barges, rods, reels, or tackle.
official_description: Harvest marine life for human or animal consumption, using diving or dredging equipment, traps, barges, rods, reels, or tackle.
activity_quote: Four fishermen were conducting commercial diving harvesting Sea Cucumbers in the Straits of Juan DeFuca.
incident_quote: causing the diver to lose his air supply, leading to the removal of his mask and his drowning.
rationale: Commercial diving to harvest sea cucumbers directly establishes harvesting marine food using diving equipment; loss of air drowned the diver.
confirmation_rationale: The commercial diver harvests sea cucumbers. An apparent air-line disconnection causes loss of air and drowning during the dive.

historical_description: Perform general nursery duties, such as propagating standard varieties of plant materials, collecting and germinating seeds, maintaining cuttings of plants, or controlling environmental conditions.
official_description: Perform general nursery duties, such as propagating standard varieties of plant materials, collecting and germinating seeds, maintaining cuttings of plants, or controlling environmental conditions.
activity_quote: Employee #1 and a coworker had been directed to install irrigation hoses and needed to attach a Kubota tractor, Model TL1150SG, to a trailer to transport it through a field.
incident_quote: Employee #1 was struck by a metal bar on the tractor, resulting in severe crushing injuries to his abdomen.
rationale: Nursery worker was setting up tractor/trailer transport for irrigation hoses to water new plantings, a general nursery duty; tractor maneuver crushed him.
confirmation_rationale: Nursery workers prepare to install irrigation hoses and water newly planted stock. Hitching the transport equipment during that nursery operation fatally crushes a worker.

historical_description: Tend or operate and control equipment, such as kettles, cookers, vats and tanks, and boilers, to cook ingredients or prepare products for further processing.
official_description: Tend or operate and control equipment, such as kettles, cookers, vats and tanks, and boilers, to cook ingredients or prepare products for further processing.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was in charge of attending to a kettle that contained hot tar
incident_quote: the diverter valve cap was ejected and sprayed Employee #1 with hot tar.
rationale: The worker tended a heated tar kettle that liquefied solid tar for subsequent roof application; the operative task allows preparing products for further processing.
confirmation_rationale: The worker tends a tar kettle heating solid tar for roofing. A valve problem and attempted heating of its pipe eject the cap and spray hot tar onto him.

historical_description: Collect animal or crop samples.
official_description: Collect animal or crop samples.
activity_quote: An employee was obtaining a grain sample from the top of a grain storage bin.
incident_quote: The employee was electrocuted.
rationale: Employee explicitly collected a grain sample using a probe when it contacted overhead electricity. Grain is the crop sample.
confirmation_rationale: The worker obtains a grain sample with a probe. Raising that probe contacts a power line and electrocutes him.

historical_description: Drive electric or hybrid-electric powered trucks or alternative fuel-powered trucks to transport and deliver products, livestock, or other materials.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS PLACING PALLETIZED FOOD PRODUCTS INTO THE GROUND LEVEL STORAGE COMPARTMENTS OF A WAREHOUSE.
incident_quote: HE WAS CAUGHT AND CRUSHED BETWEEN THE LOWER STORAGE RACK RAIL AND THE PRIME-MOVER ELECTRIC TRUCK.
rationale: Worker used an electric material-handling truck to place palletized food in warehouse storage; he was crushed between truck and rack.
confirmation_rationale: The employee uses an explicitly electric industrial truck to move palletized food into warehouse storage and is crushed against a rack. This supports the literal electric-truck material-transport wording; it does not establish on-road delivery or a road-truck occupation.

historical_description: Take samples of gases and conduct chemical tests to determine gas quality and sulfur or moisture content, or send samples to laboratories for analysis.
official_description: Take samples of gases and conduct chemical tests to determine gas quality and sulfur or moisture content, or send samples to laboratories for analysis.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was conducting a laboratory analysis of total sulfur in a liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sample.
incident_quote: He then approached the sample container to disconnect it from the fittings when a flash fire occurred.
rationale: The worker used a gas sampler/analyzer to determine sulfur in LPG and was burned while disconnecting the sample. This directly establishes gas sampling and chemical sulfur analysis.
confirmation_rationale: The technician connects an LPG sample to a gas sampler/analyzer to determine total sulfur. A flash fire occurs while disconnecting that sample apparatus, causing burns.

historical_description: Supervise or train other technologists, technicians, or drafters.
official_description: Supervise or train other technologists, technicians, or drafters.
activity_quote: He was training another employee on testing potential transformers.
incident_quote: Employee #1 had received an electric shock when he contacted one of the unguarded probes on the transformer
rationale: The injured employee trained and observed another worker testing potential transformers, a technical testing activity.
confirmation_rationale: The employee trains and observes a transformer-testing trainee. Contact with an exposed high-voltage probe shocks and burns the trainer during observation.

historical_description: Carry out general yard duties, such as performing shunting on railway lines.
activity_quote: He was standing in a loading yard and handling loads.
incident_quote: The back left wheel of the powered industrial truck struck Employee #1.
rationale: The driver was actively handling loads in a loading yard, a general yard duty; shunting is illustrative rather than mandatory.
confirmation_rationale: The truck driver handles loads in a loading yard. A reversing industrial truck strikes him during that yard work, and the medical examiner links a later fatal embolism to the injury.

historical_description: Adjust ink fountain flow rates.
official_description: Adjust ink fountain flow rates.
activity_quote: he made adjustments to the doctor blade to allow the ink to flow.
incident_quote: the tip of his middle finger got caught in the rollers and was partially amputated.
rationale: The worker adjusted the doctor blade to regulate ink flow onto the press rolls and was injured checking that flow.
confirmation_rationale: The press operator adjusts the doctor blade to restore ink flow and reaches to check coating while running. The rollers catch and partially amputate his fingertip.

historical_description: Perform routine maintenance, such as inspecting drives, motors, or belts, checking fluid levels, replacing filters, or doing other preventive maintenance actions.
official_description: Perform routine maintenance, such as inspecting drives, motors, or belts, checking fluid levels, replacing filters, or doing other preventive maintenance actions.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was performing preventative maintenance on a baking pan line at the Freund Baking Company.
incident_quote: his hand was pulled into the chain and sprocket drive, causing an injury that required amputation of his finger.
rationale: The injured worker was carrying out explicit preventive inspection/cleaning of conveyor drive components, within the task examples.
confirmation_rationale: Explicit preventive maintenance includes inspecting/cleaning conveyor drives. A rag catches in the energized chain drive and pulls the worker hand into the sprocket.

historical_description: Cut, shape, fit, join, mold, or otherwise process materials, using hand tools, power tools, or machinery.
official_description: Cut, shape, fit, join, mold, or otherwise process materials, using hand tools, power tools, or machinery.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was cutting narrow strips of l uan on a Delta 10-in. Unisaw
incident_quote: touched the blade with his thumb, amputating the tip of it.
rationale: The employee cut wood strips on a powered saw to make movie props, directly satisfying the material-cutting alternative.
confirmation_rationale: The worker cuts narrow wood strips for movie props with a table saw. Reaching across the blade to hold down lifting stock amputates his thumb tip.

historical_description: Install electrical equipment such as air-conditioning, heating, or ignition systems and components such as generator brushes and commutators, using hand tools.
official_description: Install electrical equipment such as air-conditioning, heating, or ignition systems and components such as generator brushes and commutators, using hand tools.
activity_quote: SOME ELECTRIC UTILITY EMPLOYEES USING UNINSULATED HAND TOOLS WERE INSTALLING NEW REGULATORS IN A SUBSTATION.
incident_quote: RECEIVED MULTIPLE SECOND DEGREE BURNS WHEN HE CONTACTED AN ENERGIZED POWER LINE.
rationale: Utility crew installed new electrical regulators using hand tools; aerial-lift worker contacted an energized line and was burned.
confirmation_rationale: Utility employees install substation regulators with hand tools. An installer contacts an energized power line and suffers burns; the illustrative equipment list is not treated as exhaustive.

historical_description: Exhibit animals at shows.
official_description: Exhibit animals at shows.
activity_quote: Employee #1, a trainee at the Los Angeles Municipal Zoo, was helping a qualified animal handler with an elephant training demonstration.
incident_quote: the elephant suddenly moved and sat down, striking Employee #1.
rationale: Zoo trainee assisted an elephant demonstration for visitors, returning finale keys beside the exhibited animal when it struck him.
confirmation_rationale: The trainee assists an elephant demonstration for zoo visitors and hands over keys for its finale. The elephant strikes him during that show participation.

historical_description: Read dials or meters to verify that equipment is functioning at specified levels.
official_description: Read dials or meters to verify that equipment is functioning at specified levels.
activity_quote: They checked the transformer secondary with a meter and noticed a fluctuation.
incident_quote: The ensuing electric arc burned both employees.
rationale: The electricians used a meter to check transformer performance, observed fluctuation, and tested the primary, directly satisfying meter verification of operating levels.
confirmation_rationale: Electricians use a meter to check transformer output and identify fluctuation. A primary-side meter failure causes an arc that burns both, one fatally.

historical_description: Provide for entertainment and set up related decorations and equipment.
official_description: Provide for entertainment and set up related decorations and equipment.
activity_quote: the employee brought some of his personal decorations including a fogging machine to the establishment and proceeded to decorate.
incident_quote: an employee suffered a head injury when he fell from a port able metal ladder while hanging Halloween decorations
rationale: Worker supplied and installed Halloween decorations and a fogging machine for the restaurant to coincide with a block party; he fell while decorating.
confirmation_rationale: The employee decorates the restaurant for a Halloween block party, including a fog machine. He falls from the ladder while hanging decorations; the source truncates later investigative detail but clearly establishes task and head injury.

historical_description: Maintain inventories of supplies.
official_description: Maintain inventories of supplies.
activity_quote: to perform an inventory of supplies in a walk-in freezer.
incident_quote: As Employee #1 came down from looking at the top shelf, he misstepped, fell, and fractured his left ankle.
rationale: Chef explicitly inventoried freezer supplies using a stool when he fell, fully establishing supply inventory work.
confirmation_rationale: The chef inventories freezer supplies from a step stool. He falls while descending after checking the top shelf and fractures his ankle.

historical_description: Monitor traffic to ensure motorists observe traffic regulations and exhibit safe driving procedures.
official_description: Monitor traffic to ensure motorists observe traffic regulations and exhibit safe driving procedures.
activity_quote: was conducting traffic surveillance for a client.
incident_quote: swung the gate arm into Employee #1, striking him in the back and knocking him to the ground.
rationale: Security officer monitored departing traffic, identified an overheight truck load and warned its driver; the collision with the gate struck him.
confirmation_rationale: The security officer watches departing traffic, notices an overheight load and warns the driver. The load hits the gate apparatus and swings the arm into him.

historical_description: Calibrate or maintain machines, such as those used for plasma collection.
official_description: Calibrate or maintain machines, such as those used for plasma collection.
activity_quote: the employee was replacing a defective optical fiber cable.
incident_quote: He contacted a circuit part energized at either 30 or 50 kilovolts, DC, and received an electric shock.
rationale: Replacing a defective optical fiber cable maintains plasma-source equipment; machine example is illustrative and replacement is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: Replacing a defective optical-fiber cable maintains the described ion equipment. Contact with an energized high-voltage part shocks and injures the worker; plasma collection is an illustrative example, not the reported equipment.

historical_description: Receive, set up, test, or decontaminate equipment.
official_description: Receive, set up, test, or decontaminate equipment.
activity_quote: They were setting up MOT (maintenance of traffic) materials/devices.
incident_quote: The vehicle struck and killed Employees #1 and #2
rationale: Employees set up traffic-control equipment at a road project when a vehicle entered the closure and killed them.
confirmation_rationale: The crew sets up traffic-maintenance devices inside a highway closure. A vehicle enters the closure and kills two workers during setup.

historical_description: Conduct or direct system-level automotive testing.
official_description: Conduct or direct system-level automotive testing.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was working in the service and repair shop troubleshooting a computer problem, a MIL ("check engine light"),
incident_quote: During his work he unplugged the wiring harness between the vehicle transmission and the ECU, causing the vehicle leveling system jacks to automatically retract and the rear of the vehicle to drop.
rationale: System-level vehicle diagnostics are explicit: using a code scanner to investigate a check-engine indicator and troubleshooting ECU communication. Disconnecting the transmission/ECU harness during that investigation retracts the leveling system and fatally crushes the worker.
confirmation_rationale: The technician used a code scanner and investigated communication through transmission/ECU wiring to diagnose the vehicle check-engine system. This is automotive system testing, and harness disconnection during that diagnosis retracted the support jacks.

historical_description: Take product samples during or after processing for laboratory analyses.
official_description: Take product samples during or after processing for laboratory analyses.
activity_quote: A sampling rod was provided with an attached plastic quart sized cup to fill and then pour into a larger gallon jar to take to the quality lab for analysis.
incident_quote: The cause of death was asphyxia due to oxygen deficient atmosphere.
rationale: The employee collects pigment samples for a quality lab. Retrieving dropped sampling equipment puts him into the nitrogen-blanketed tank and causes fatal asphyxia.
confirmation_rationale: Worker sampled pigment from a blending tank for quality-lab analysis and fell into the tank retrieving dropped sampling equipment; action, product and analysis purpose are explicit.

historical_description: Prepare repair cost estimates.
activity_quote: He was preparing an estimate of the cost of replacing damaged ductwork for the unit.
incident_quote: the employee moved the air conditioner and was electrocuted.
rationale: Repair-company salesman inspected damaged AC ductwork to prepare replacement cost estimate; moving the unit for access electrocuted him.
confirmation_rationale: The salesman examines damaged ductwork to prepare a replacement estimate. Moving the associated air conditioner to access it causes electrocution.

historical_description: Transfer luggage, trunks, and packages to and from rooms, loading areas, vehicles, or transportation terminals, by hand or using baggage carts.
official_description: Transfer luggage, trunks, and packages to and from rooms, loading areas, vehicles, or transportation terminals, by hand or using baggage carts.
activity_quote: He was transferring passenger baggage from an airplane to a baggage cart.
incident_quote: He sustained the partial amputation of the fingertip.
rationale: The airline worker transfers passenger baggage using carts. During that operation he disconnects a cart and directs the tug forward before clearing his hand, producing a hitch-related fingertip amputation.
confirmation_rationale: The baggage transfer from airplane to cart is explicit, and uncoupling those carts exposed his finger to the hitch.

historical_description: Identify and resolve equipment malfunctions, working with manufacturers or field representatives as necessary to procure replacement parts.
official_description: Identify and resolve equipment malfunctions, working with manufacturers or field representatives as necessary to procure replacement parts.
activity_quote: The track on the excavator came loose from the drive mechanism and the employees were attempting to repair it in the field.
incident_quote: The excavator tipped over crushing Employee #1 's foot
rationale: Crew identified a loose excavator track and performed field repair; excavator tipping crushed the involved worker. Manufacturer consultation is conditional.
confirmation_rationale: The crew identifies a loose excavator track and attempts field repair. The excavator overturns during the repair and crushes the worker foot; outside procurement is conditional.

historical_description: Transport materials, tools, or machines to installation sites, manually or using conveyance equipment.
official_description: Transport materials, tools, or machines to installation sites, manually or using conveyance equipment.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was operating a rotating conveyor system. The conveyor transports concrete to the construction site from a remote concrete production facility.
incident_quote: The conveyor system failed structurally and collapsed.
rationale: The employee operates equipment conveying concrete to the construction site. Structural failure drops the attached operator cab and injures him during that material transport.
confirmation_rationale: The employee operated the conveyor conveying concrete to the construction installation site; collapse of that conveyance injured him.

historical_description: Observe and monitor equipment operation during the extraction process to detect any problems.
official_description: Observe and monitor equipment operation during the extraction process to detect any problems.
activity_quote: While performing the extraction process, he smelled propane gas and observed an electric spark from a nearby piece of equipment.
incident_quote: An explosion occurred, injuring the employee.
rationale: During cannabis extraction the employee detects propane and observes an equipment spark immediately before an explosion. This supports observation of equipment problems during extraction without assuming monitoring was his exclusive duty.
confirmation_rationale: The extraction operator detected gas and an equipment spark during active extraction, directly documenting equipment/process monitoring and a detected problem.

historical_description: Pack customer purchases in bags or cartons.
official_description: Pack customer purchases in bags or cartons.
activity_quote: The company repackaged the smaller bags into a larger container or bag for a customer.
incident_quote: the employee fell from the platform.
rationale: Worker repacked customer material from small bags through a hopper into a large bag; he fell from the loading platform during this bagging operation.
confirmation_rationale: The employee repackages titanium dioxide from small bags into a larger customer container. He falls from the packing platform while loading is underway.

historical_description: Record production and test data, such as processing steps, temperature and steam readings, cooking time, batches processed, and test results.
official_description: Record production and test data, such as processing steps, temperature and steam readings, cooking time, batches processed, and test results.
activity_quote: He was recording data from a test and checking on the process.
incident_quote: He began vomiting, he became lethargic, and his pulse rate dropped.
rationale: Operations manager recorded test data and checked a pharmaceutical milling process when symptoms of exposure developed.
confirmation_rationale: The operation manager records test data and checks milling of a pharmaceutical powder without a respirator. He develops vomiting, lethargy and low pulse during that process and is hospitalized.

historical_description: Tend accessory equipment, such as pumps and conveyors, to move materials or ingredients through production processes.
official_description: Tend accessory equipment, such as pumps and conveyors, to move materials or ingredients through production processes.
activity_quote: an employee was troubleshooting the reason for damaged product on a production line and was inspecting the pins of a chain conveyor.
incident_quote: The employee suffered an amputation to end of his right ring finger
rationale: The employee tends a conveyor carrying cans through production by inspecting its moving pins for defects. Contact with the running chain/sprocket during that inspection amputates his fingertip.
confirmation_rationale: The employee tended the running can-transfer conveyor by inspecting its pins to remedy production damage. The conveyor is explicitly carrying cans through the process.

historical_description: Observe machine operation to detect workpiece defects or machine malfunctions, adjusting machines as necessary.
official_description: Observe machine operation to detect workpiece defects or machine malfunctions, adjusting machines as necessary.
activity_quote: When the machine would not operate and make a weld, an adjustment to a mechanical sensor was necessary.
incident_quote: The employee caught his right hand in a pinch point.
rationale: Workers observed a welding press failing to weld, then employee adjusted its sensor with a wrench; the head moved and injured his hand.
confirmation_rationale: The crew attempts a weld, observes machine failure and adjusts its sensor with a wrench. The welding head moves during the adjustment and severely injures the employee hand.

historical_description: Provide staff with assistance in performing difficult or complicated duties.
official_description: Provide staff with assistance in performing difficult or complicated duties.
activity_quote: The two workers were trying to remove the dumpster from the truck. The temporary employee, working as the helper, had climbed onto the frame of the truck. He was using his hands to dislodge the container from the hopper.
incident_quote: His hand was amputated at the wrist.
rationale: The employee works as a helper jointly resolving an abnormal lodged dumpster that fell into the truck hopper. He assists his coworker with that difficult removal and inadvertently activates the compactor, amputating his hand.
confirmation_rationale: The temporary helper assisted his coworker with the abnormal difficult task of dislodging a fallen dumpster from the truck hopper.

historical_description: Test electrical systems or continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures, using testing devices, such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, or oscilloscopes, to ensure compatibility and safety of system.
official_description: Test electrical systems or continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures, using testing devices, such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, or oscilloscopes, to ensure compatibility and safety of system.
activity_quote: HE THEN MADE CONTINUITY AND VOLTAGE CHECKS AND FOUND VOLTAGE IMPRESSED ON THE HOIST CHAIN.
incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE LATER DIED FROM THE SHOCK HE RECEIVED.
rationale: The electrician performs continuity and voltage checks on crane wiring and discovers an energized hoist chain. Disconnecting the test power arrangement to deenergize it then fatally shocks him. Electrical measurement is explicit although the particular meter is unnamed.
confirmation_rationale: The electrician performed continuity and voltage measurements to troubleshoot the crane, discovered unsafe voltage and was shocked while disconnecting it. The measurements establish testing-device use even though the meter model is unnamed.

historical_description: Disassemble defective parts or components, such as inaccurate or worn gauges or measuring instruments.
official_description: Disassemble defective parts or components, such as inaccurate or worn gauges or measuring instruments.
activity_quote: another contractor's crew was removing a defective sight level gauge from a propane relief drum in a scrubber system.
incident_quote: The autopsy report listed hydrogen sulfide poisoning as the immediate cause of death.
rationale: Removal of a defective level gauge is explicit. Product spills from the gauge during that removal and a nearby worker develops chest symptoms and dies with hydrogen-sulfide poisoning, directly linking the other crew activity to the incident.
confirmation_rationale: The directly involved crew removed a defective measuring gauge from the system, releasing its hazardous contents and exposing the nearby victim.

historical_description: Perform physically demanding tasks, such as digging trenches to lay conduit or moving or lifting heavy objects.
official_description: Perform physically demanding tasks, such as digging trenches to lay conduit or moving or lifting heavy objects.
activity_quote: he manually dug himself another hole within the trench
incident_quote: the employee suffered two fractured ribs and a fractured right scapula.
rationale: The worker manually excavates within a trench while locating electrical lines and directing a backhoe. The trench wall collapses onto him, fracturing ribs and scapula.
confirmation_rationale: Manual excavation of an additional hole within a trench is a physically demanding task; illustrative conduit purpose is not required. Collapse occurred in that excavation.

historical_description: Remove grease, dirt, paint, or rust from surfaces in preparation for paint application, using abrasives, solvents, brushes, blowtorches, washing tanks, or sandblasters.
official_description: Remove grease, dirt, paint, or rust from surfaces in preparation for paint application, using abrasives, solvents, brushes, blowtorches, washing tanks, or sandblasters.
activity_quote: Cylinders are first checked for leaks, and those with rust are cleaned by abrasive blasting before being repainted.
incident_quote: The door struck Employee #1, who sustained chest injuries.
rationale: Rust removal by abrasive blasting before repainting is the specified process, and a cylinder leaks during that actual cleaning. The resulting explosion injures both workers at the blasting unit.
confirmation_rationale: The active abrasive-blasting operation cleaned rusty propane cylinders before repainting. A leaking cylinder exploded inside that cleaning unit and injured its workers.

historical_description: Observe machine operations to detect any problems, making necessary adjustments to correct problems.
official_description: Observe machine operations to detect any problems, making necessary adjustments to correct problems.
activity_quote: He was monitoring the operation of an automated freezer and correcting any problems that arose.
incident_quote: it cycled through, dragging his hand into the equipment.
rationale: Worker monitored automated freezer problems and checked its malfunctioning rake/microswitch to correct operation; the rake cycled and injured his hand.
confirmation_rationale: The trainee monitors automated freezer operation and enters to correct a rake problem. The rake cycles while his hand is on it and fractures/degloves the hand.

historical_description: Provide assistance to the public, such as directions to court offices.
official_description: Provide assistance to the public, such as directions to court offices.
activity_quote: His office activities included interacting with citizens by appointment or walk-in to applying and maintaining court-required monitoring devices.
incident_quote: At 6:00 a.m. on January 24, 2021, he died.
rationale: The employee provides citizens court-monitoring-device application and maintenance services. A symptomatic client enters the small service office before worker illness, documenting a plausible exposure opportunity without proving the source.
confirmation_rationale: Supervisor personally assisted citizens with court-required monitoring devices, a public-service activity; symptomatic client entered the small service office and preceded employee illness.

historical_description: Tend pumps, compressors, or generators to provide power for tools, machinery, or equipment or to heat or move materials, such as asphalt.
official_description: Tend pumps, compressors, or generators to provide power for tools, machinery, or equipment or to heat or move materials, such as asphalt.
activity_quote: He put the power take-off in gear to activate the pump and begin supplying the hot liquid asphalt to the delivery tank.
incident_quote: As he was working, the 3 in. wide nitrile discharge hose ruptured, and 310 degree F liquid asphalt struck Employee #1;
rationale: The worker connects and runs the asphalt-transfer pump. Although he also cleans vehicle windows while transfer continues, the operating pump/hose system directly releases the hot asphalt that burns him.
confirmation_rationale: The driver operated the pump to transfer hot asphalt. Although he was cleaning windows when injured, the same operating pump/discharge hose directly generated the burn exposure, so I classify this as incident-involved.

historical_description: Align and clamp workpieces together, using rules, squares, or hand tools, or position items in fixtures, jigs, or vises.
official_description: Align and clamp workpieces together, using rules, squares, or hand tools, or position items in fixtures, jigs, or vises.
activity_quote: The employee had placed a part into the lower mold and activated the two-hand trip controls to allow the alignment portion to slide forward.
incident_quote: the employee's left index fingertip was amputated.
rationale: Placing a part in the lower mold establishes the positioning-in-fixtures branch. The employee then manually aligns clamps and is injured resetting a misaligned clamp during that setup.
confirmation_rationale: Positioning the part in the mold fixture satisfies the task's alternative. He then aligned clamps and was injured correcting a clamp fault.

historical_description: Perform housekeeping duties, such as laundry, cleaning, dish washing, and changing of linens.
official_description: Perform housekeeping duties, such as laundry, cleaning, dish washing, and changing of linens.
activity_quote: the employee had cleaned three non-isolation rooms, and two positive or suspected COVID-19 isolations rooms.
incident_quote: an employee who worked for a janitorial service died from COVID-19.
rationale: The housekeeper cleans and removes trash/linens in a medical center, including recent cleaning of COVID isolation rooms. This establishes a plausible task-linked exposure opportunity without proving the infection source.
confirmation_rationale: Housekeeper personally cleaned medical-center rooms including COVID isolation rooms before infection, directly establishing housekeeping activities in the described exposure context.

historical_description: Maintain instruments, equipment, or machinery to ensure proper working condition.
official_description: Maintain instruments, equipment, or machinery to ensure proper working condition.
activity_quote: an employee opened the door of the band strap machine to push the strap back into position
incident_quote: The employee's finger was lacerated and amputated in the chain/sprocket.
rationale: Worker repositioned a displaced strap inside a malfunctioning banding machine to restore operation; running drive caught his glove and finger.
confirmation_rationale: The worker restores a displaced strapping-machine strap to its feed position so it can operate properly. His glove catches the running chain/sprocket and his finger is amputated.

historical_description: Monitor or trace the location of goods.
official_description: Monitor or trace the location of goods.
activity_quote: He parked and got off his forklift truck to scan the product for tracking.
incident_quote: The fingertip of the employee's left index finger was pulled into the chain.
rationale: Material handler scanned freight for tracking at the dock; glove string caught in the forklift chain during the scan.
confirmation_rationale: The material handler scans freight expressly for tracking its location. While scanning with one hand, his other glove catches in the forklift chain, causing a fingertip amputation.

historical_description: Escort young children across roads or highways.
official_description: Escort young children across roads or highways.
activity_quote: an employee was performing her duties as a school crossing guard, escorting children and pedestrians across the street.
incident_quote: The employee was struck and killed by a dump truck making a right turn into the intersection.
rationale: The school crossing guard actively escorts children across the street and is struck by a turning dump truck during that work.
confirmation_rationale: The crossing guard was actively escorting schoolchildren across the street when struck.

historical_description: Cut excess material or thread from finished products.
official_description: Cut excess material or thread from finished products.
activity_quote: the cutter process caused the machine to throw off excess bubble wrap material.
incident_quote: his right hand became entangled in the in-running nip point of a drive pulley for the excess take-up wheel.
rationale: The worker operates a cutter producing excess bubble wrap and coils the resulting trim for disposal. The take-up mechanism catches his hand in that cutting/trim-handling operation.
confirmation_rationale: Operator cut produced bubble-wrap material and handled the excess generated by the cut; the resulting excess take-up pulley entangled his hand. This directly establishes cutting excess from manufactured product.

historical_description: Assemble or set up displays, furniture, or products in store space, using colors, lights, pictures, or other accessories to display the product.
official_description: Assemble or set up displays, furniture, or products in store space, using colors, lights, pictures, or other accessories to display the product.
activity_quote: was setting up ceiling lights and fans display.
incident_quote: Employee #1 died from head and neck injuries.
rationale: Hardware-store salesperson set up a ceiling-light/fan retail display when he fell fatally.
confirmation_rationale: The hardware-store sales worker sets up a ceiling-light and fan display. He falls to the concrete floor during that display setup and dies from head/neck injuries.
